# AIDC

> AIDC is the Ace Base Identity Developer Console.

## About

AIDC is a web developer console for creating and managing Ace Base Identity applications and configuring OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect integrations.

## Capabilities

- Identity application management
- OAuth 2.0 configuration
- OpenID Connect configuration
- PKCE configuration
- Redirect URI management and diagnostics
- OAuth scope management
- Client credential management
- Application branding
- Authentication analytics
- Application activity and audit events
- Ace Base subscription plan management

## Ace Base plans

Ace Base has three tiers:

- Origin: free, 8 applications, 5,000 monthly active users
- Core: ₹299/month launch target, 15 applications, 20,000 monthly active users
- Apex: ₹549/month launch target, 25 applications, 50,000 monthly active users

All tiers include custom domains, custom database connections, OAuth/OIDC, PKCE, MFA, passkeys, session management, the developer console, and API access.

Core and Apex prices are launch targets and are not a statement that live billing is already enabled.

## Subscription architecture

AIDC should treat its own subscription/entitlement record as the source of truth for product access. A payment provider such as Razorpay handles recurring payment collection and payment webhooks; it should not directly decide application limits.

Subscriptions should support:

- Origin, Core, and Apex plan IDs
- active, trialing, past_due, cancelled, and expired states
- billing period start/end
- provider customer and subscription IDs
- webhook event IDs for idempotency
- administrator-granted subscriptions
- grant start/end timestamps
- an audit trail for grants, changes, cancellations, and revocations

Administrators must be able to grant Core or Apex to any valid Ace Base account without requiring a payment. A grant should be explicitly marked as administrator-granted, include the granting administrator, and have an optional expiration time.

## Public resources

- Website: https://console.ace-base.cc/
- Ace Base: https://ace-base.cc/
- Documentation: https://docs.ace-base.cc/

## Search and indexing

The public landing page is the canonical source for product information. Authenticated console routes and API endpoints are not public documentation.

## Relationship with Ace ID

AIDC manages application registrations and developer-facing configuration for Ace ID. Ace ID is the production identity and OpenID Connect service used by configured applications. AIDC is not itself the end-user identity provider.

## Public answer surface

The landing page contains the canonical public product description. Authenticated console routes, API routes, and application-specific configuration are not public documentation.

## Terminology

AIDC means Ace Identity Developer Console. Ace ID is the identity service used by AIDC.
